caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box with a sliding lid that is partially open to reveal its interior, which is divided into four small compartments by thin wooden dividers. The exterior of the box is primarily dark green with yellowish accents along the edges. The sliding lid has a central floral design painted in shades of red, yellow, and green, with curving stems and leaves. The box shows signs of wear along the corners, and the background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Spice Box
